atoms.b: Last week, I read a novel about time travelling. There was a couple that lived a hundred years apart from each other but travelled across time to be together. That was so ((++romantic scary)). Also, it was very ((++tense comical)) because one of them was followed by the police and had to run away again and again.

I read a book about a guy that climbed Mount Everest. I couldn't stop reading because I found it so ((++exciting corny)). To see how he managed the cold weather and many miles was really ((++entertaining romantic)). In the end, it was pretty ((++sentimental clever)) because he was so happy to have reached his goal.

I didn't like the book we read in German class. There was a lot going on, so it was ((++action-packed corny)), which I like, but there were also sad parts which were kind of ((++depressing funny)). Additionally, it wasn't ((++comical sentimental)) at all. I didn't like that because for me, funny books are more ((++enjoyable crazy)).
